definitions.short: an assessment (as based upon a census)
definitions.full: H4371. mekes מֶ֫כֶס noun masculine computation, proportion to be paid, tax (Palmyrene מכסא Reckend ZMG 1885, 379 ff. ; Late Hebrew מֶכֶס , Aramaic מִכְסָא , tax (hence Arabic as loan-word Frä 283 ); Assyrian miksu , Dl HWB 407 (√ מכס ); Late Hebrew מוֺכֵס tax-collector ; so Assyrian makkasu, compare Arabic ) — Num 31:28 מ ׳זַהֲרֵמֹתָ֫ ׳לי and thou shalt separate a tax (duty levied on the spoil) for ׳י , 31:37 ; 31:38 ; 31:39 ; 31:40 ; 31:41 (all P).
